questions.question: What is the SI unit of force?
questions.explanation: The SI unit of force is the Newton (N).

questions.question: Which of these is a vector quantity?
questions.explanation: Velocity is a vector quantity because it has both magnitude and direction.

questions.question: What is the acceleration due to gravity on Earth?
questions.explanation: The acceleration due to gravity on Earth is approximately 9.8 m/s².

questions.question: What is the SI unit of work?
questions.explanation: The SI unit of work is the Joule (J).

questions.question: Which of these is a scalar quantity?
questions.explanation: Speed is a scalar quantity because it only has magnitude, not direction.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of power?
questions.explanation: The SI unit of power is the Watt (W).
